question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Rare
solution: The correct answer is **"Usual."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Rare"** means something that is not common or occurs infrequently. (दुर्लभ, विरल (बहुत कम किया जाने, दीखने या होने वाला)) • **Example**: *This is a **rare**__ breed of dogs.* • The antonym of** "rare" **is** "usual.'** • **"Usual"** means something that is common or occurs frequently. (बहुधा होने या प्रयोग में आने वाला, हमेशा वाला) __ • **Example**:* It’s **usual**__ for her to work at weekends.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (Careless)** means not giving enough attention or thought to something. (असावधान, लापरवाह) • **Option 3 (Discreet**) means being careful and cautious in one's speech or actions. (सावधान, सतर्क (कि दूसरे को परेशानी न हो)) • **Option 4 (Unique)** means being one of a kind or having no equal. (जिसके समान दूसरा नहीं, अनन्‍य, अद्वितीय, बेजोड़; अपनी तरह का अकेला, एकल) 3b:Td3f, The correct answer is **"Deplete."**
